tasks.title: Conversation #8
tasks.transcript:
WOMAN: Do you know if enough people have registered for the computer class? I have to let Mr. Terrance know whether the class is going to open or not.
MEN: I checked the list earlier, and there were many who had already registered.
I think it's safe to tell Mr. Terrance that the class is going to be held. In fact, ask him if he would be interested in opening an extra class? Registration lasts until this Friday, and I think there is a good chance that we could fill another class.
WOMAN: I think he would be happy to hear that. I will call him right away to see what he says.
MEN: Thanks, and could you also do me a favor and see how many people have registered for the cooking class?

questions.stem: What does Mr. Terrance want to know?

options.B: How fast the computers will be set up.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问Mr. Terrance想知道什么，属于推理判断题，需根据女士的话推断Mr. Terrance关注的核心问题。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 女士开头明确说“Do you know if enough people have registered for the computer class? I have to let Mr. Terrance know whether the class is going to open or not.”，说明Mr. Terrance需要知道是否有足够的学生报名，以决定课程是否开设。 选项B：错误。 对话中完全没有提到电脑设置速度的问题，属于与原文无关的干扰项。 选项C：错误。 对话末尾提到了烹饪课，但这是男士请女士帮忙查询的内容，与Mr. Terrance想知道的事情无关，且“食物味道如何”也未在对话中出现。 选项D：错误。 男士提到注册截止日期是本周五（Registration lasts until this Friday），但这是男士提供的信息，并非Mr. Terrance想知道的内容。

options.A: The man will buy a new computer.
options.B: The registration period will come to an end.
options.C: The woman will receive her diploma.
options.D: They will dine in a fine restaurant.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问本周五会发生什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住对话中明确提到的时间信息。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 对话中完全没有提到男士要买新电脑，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 男士明确说“Registration lasts until this Friday”，即注册持续到本周五，因此本周五注册期将结束。 选项C：错误。 对话中完全没有提到女士获得文凭的事情，属于与原文无关的干扰项。 选项D：错误。 对话末尾提到了烹饪课，但并未说他们要在高级餐厅用餐，属于凭空捏造。
